verified_facts.text: The resort is an all-inclusive hotel located in Playa Bávaro, Punta Cana.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a family vacation at this all-inclusive hotel located in Playa Bávaro.

verified_facts.text: The resort has a water park called Aquazone with slides and splash zones.
verified_facts.excerpt: Aquazone is the perfect place for kids and families to enjoy a world of aquatic fun in Punta Cana. Slides, splash zones and supervised activities

verified_facts.text: The Kidsdom kids' program is designed for young people between 1 and 16 years old, with experiences adapted to each age.
verified_facts.excerpt: with a program carefully designed for young people between 1 and 16 years old, with experiences adapted to each age.

verified_facts.text: Guests get free and unlimited access to the Fun Republic Entertainment Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Benefit from free and unlimited access to this vibrant entertainment destination.

verified_facts.text: The Family Concierge service offers personalized attention and access to exclusive areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy personalized attention, sophisticated amenities, and access to exclusive areas tailored for the most discerning guests.

verified_facts.text: Family Concierge guests have a Destination Concierge available 24/7 for activity or restaurant bookings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Destination Concierge will be on hand 24/7, ready to take care of all your activity or restaurant bookings, and offer you a private tour of the resort.

verified_facts.text: Family Concierge perks include private check-in and check-out and a reserved beach area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reserved beach area

verified_facts.text: Swim-Up Suites have a private solarium with whirlpool bathtub and direct access to the pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Private solarium with whirlpool bathtub, direct access to a magnificent pool, and spectacular views.

verified_facts.text: The Suite has a terrace with a whirlpool bathtub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treat yourself to moments of relaxation on the terrace with a whirlpool bathtub.

verified_facts.text: Sal is a modern steakhouse inspired by the work of Picasso, with a private room for celebrations.

verified_facts.text: Tori is an Asian fusion restaurant with a sushi bar, robotayaki and teppanyaki tables.

verified_facts.excerpt: Try signature ceviches, tiraditos, pokes, and delicious tartares at Playa Bávaro.

verified_facts.text: Agua Marina by Leandro Díaz combines Caribbean flavors with contemporary cuisine in a beachfront setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover a restaurant where the flavors of the Caribbean meet contemporary cuisine in an elegant beachfront setting.

verified_facts.text: Mama & Juana is a poolside cocktail bar with daily performances, named after the Dominican drink Mama Juana.

verified_facts.text: YHI Spa's services are certified by Wellness for Cancer.
